This directory vendors unmodified build artifacts from the open-source FFmpeg.wasm project, self-hosted here instead of loaded from a third-party CDN so the app has no runtime dependency on external code delivery.

- `ffmpeg-core/` — @ffmpeg/core v0.12.10 (LGPL v2.1+, built from FFmpeg), https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
